retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album layout featuring a centered studio portrait against a solid warm backdrop with heavy, tightly-spaced display serifs at the top and a block of sans-serif track listings at the bottom.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body studio portrait of a seated figure on a solid, warm-toned background, framed by a large-scale, high-contrast serif title at the top and a multi-line block of yellow sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic header balancing the centered subject
Warm monochromatic background unifying the composition
High-contrast white display type against a dark saturated field
Bottom-aligned text block acting as a visual base
coreInvariants: Tightly tracked display serif with overlapping characters
Centered subject with limbs creating diagonal lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, full-body seated figure occupying the middle 50% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale white serif title at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top header, moves down to the subject's face, follows the diagonal of the legs, and rests on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space around the subject to emphasize the studio setting.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary display typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted yellow for secondary metadata text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast modern serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display type features extreme stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast display serif for impact paired with a functional sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Small logo/catalog number in top left corner

preserve: High contrast of the serif strokes
avoid: Wide letter spacing in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme stroke contrast and vertical stress.
Matches the clean, functional look of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a person in 1960s attire seated on a solid terracotta red floor and background. Ensure ample empty space at the top and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a white, tightly-tracked Didot-style font at the top. Add a block of yellow sans-serif text at the bottom, centered and separated by bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the top text white and touching/overlapping?
Is the background a solid, warm red/terracotta?
Is the bottom text block yellow and centered?
Is the subject centered with clear negative space around them?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in the bottom text block

avoid: Modern sans-serifs for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check for character overlap in the header
Verify the yellow color of the bottom text
Ensure the subject is not obscured by typography
Confirm the absence of modern gradients
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid warm background + Centered 60s portrait + Overlapping white Didot header + Yellow sans-serif footer block.
